findings.message: AC-2's fix covers only the Connect GitHub suggestion and the Overview nudge. A third place still invites people to connect: the Git accounts page (modules/git-accounts/ui/GitAccountsPage.tsx:38). It shows the primary 'Ask amax · Connect GitHub' button whenever `myGitAccounts().configured` is true, and that flag only checks that a credential exists (`hasSecret`). So an incomplete or unreadable app still asks everyone on the page to connect, and each attempt then fails. This is the problem 119 sets out to fix. Fix: make the page decide from `githubAppStatus(v).state === 'ready'`, the same check the suggestion and nudge use. For the other states, show why connecting isn't possible (incomplete, expired or not set up) instead of the button. Add a test row for the page next to state-119's `invited()` check for each state.
findings.scenario: An Admin stores the github-oauth value 'only-the-secret-00000000000000'. Kasun, an Engineer, opens /git-accounts: the suggestion is hidden and status reads 'incomplete', but the card still shows 'Ask amax · Connect GitHub'. Confirming it fails with APP_INCOMPLETE.

findings.message: The app check now runs as a job for every viewer, including on every Engineer's Overview render and on the Connect suggestion. useSecret writes `last_used_at`, `last_used_by` and `last_used_purpose` on the credential (packages/core/src/secrets/use.ts:53), so the Keys screen's 'Last used' for github-oauth now shows the 'GitHub app check' at least once every CHECK_MS per process. A real connect use gets overwritten. Until 119 only Admin views did this. Before 119 the stamp was close to the app's real use; now it records that someone looked at a page. Fix: keep the status check from stamping last-used. Either use a read that doesn't stamp usage, or skip the stamp for the 'GitHub app check' purpose. The decrypt can stay audited.
findings.scenario: No one has connected GitHub for 3 months, and Engineers open Overview daily. An Admin checks Settings → Keys before following 'Remove the GitHub app … as unused'. It shows 'Last used 10:02 today · GitHub app check', so the app looks in use.
